title: Your real estate on the search page
header_line: My analysis of one book on authority and personal brand. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What comes up first when someone searches your trade?

I said that anytime anybody types a word into a search engine, you are in or out of the results, and I called it the internet real estate highway. I said you have to have this order, or you will not create the leverage.
I showed that searching a person's business name brings them up first, but only somebody who already knows the name will type it. I then tried a generic search for the trade and city.
A student said: if you type in just graphic design and the city, I do not come up at all.
I said that the challenge is how to change that, and that writing articles in several local publications using the right words is one way.
I said that I built a country's tourism website by building a database of thousands of keywords of people wanting to visit. I said to take a short course on hashtag strategies.
I said that veterans can just publish articles to stay relevant, for fun, and perhaps get a speaking engagement.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Search your trade and city and write where you appear.
Write the words your customers type.
Write three publications that could carry an article.

recap: Be found by people who do not know your name yet.
